# clean-titles map (generated by build.py: do not edit)

Server = files/server/NN-*.js (built into files/index.js), page = files/page/NN-*.js (built into files/ct-page.js after core.js + answers.js): edit the modules.

## other
- ../autoupdate-job.ps1: the PC's update job: every minute, installs a new main within ~1 min, sends reports (Issue() puts update problems on the server for ⚑ Report)
- ../install.ps1: generated by patch_installer.py; never read whole, grep it
- test/*.test.js: bun tests (they load the BUILT ct-page.js / index.js); test/render.js: degoog's result template for tests
- test/headless/run.cjs: headless Chrome check (layout shift, pass ms, endless-scroll page 2: page2/lost/ahead); stub page without rec/
